summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and shuffled string-property maps) and, at install time, probes the host libc/Alpine, downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime tarball from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a bundled sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled single-line bundle (header "// @bun @bun-cjs") using string-array rotation obfuscation, with fragmented tokens in the string table consistent with runtime-reassembled URLs/endpoints. The package's advertised purpose is Slack/Teams message content building, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate language runtime at install time to execute an opaque, heavily obfuscated sibling script. Installing this package auto-runs the obfuscated payload under Bun on the installer's machine, giving whatever math_init.js contains full install-time code execution.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
